features.title: Features
features.hint: A pillar that is off keeps its pages, but nothing runs

gsx.label: GSX ground services
gsx.hint: Departure services, doors, jetway, pushback and arrival through GSX Pro.

speech.label: Voice First Officer
speech.hint: Spoken checklists, callouts, briefings and voice commands.

audio.label: Audio control
audio.hint: Audio panel knobs and latches set app volumes.

host.label: ProSim host
host.hint: Name or IP address of the PC that runs ProSim System.

sdk.label: ProSim SDK folder
sdk.hint: The folder that contains ProSimSDK.dll. Empty keeps ProSim off.

api.label: API key
api.hint: Only newer ProSim builds use one. Leave empty otherwise.

setupCheck.title: ProSim Setup Check
setupCheck.hintIdle: Reads on every ProSim connection; writes only when you click Apply

enabled.label: Check ProSim's options on connect
enabled.hint: Reads the IOS options this app depends on and shows which ones differ. Never changes anything by itself.
enabled.more: Door logic, automatic ground power, datalink loading and the refuelling rate. Rows for a feature that is switched off above are not shown.

setupCheck.keepTitle: Keep this option as it is. The row stays grey and Apply never touches it.
setupCheck.readAgainTitle: Read the options from ProSim again.
setupCheck.howTitle: How to change the options by hand in ProSim System.
setupCheck.applyTitle: Writes the recommended value to every amber row, then reads them back. Takes effect at once; no ProSim restart.

navData.title: Nav Data
navData.hint: Navigraph database for SIDs, STARs and approaches

dfd.label: DFD database path
dfd.hint: The .s3db file or its folder. ProSim's Navdata folder works. Empty looks next to the SDK.

weather.title: Weather Sources
weather.hint: ActiveSky carries the weather actually in the sim, so it wins over the ProSim gateway and SayIntentions when present

snapshot.label: ActiveSky snapshot file
snapshot.hint: Full path of current_wx_snapshot.txt. Empty looks in the known HiFi install folders.
snapshot.more: When set, the path is final: a missing file switches the snapshot tier off instead of looking elsewhere.

useApi.label: Also try the ActiveSky API
useApi.hint: ActiveSky's local web API, when the snapshot has nothing for the airport.

apiHost.label: API host
apiHost.hint: Name or IP address of the PC running ActiveSky.

apiTimeout.label: API timeout
apiTimeout.hint: Short on purpose: the chain moves on fast when ActiveSky is not running.

web.title: Web Interface
web.hint: Port and LAN access are also editable in the desktop window

port.label: Port
port.hint: Takes effect after an app restart.

lan.label: Allow other devices (LAN)
lan.hint: Tablets and other PCs can open this page.
lan.more: They sign in with the QR code in the desktop window.

https.label: Enable HTTPS
https.hint: A second, secure address beside the normal one. Needed for keep-awake and the installed app on tablets. Takes effect after a restart.
https.more: You supply the certificate: a PFX file for this PC's LAN address, made with your own CA (mkcert is the easy way) and that CA installed on the tablet. The app never makes or installs certificates. If the file is missing or wrong, HTTP keeps working and a banner says why.

httpsPort.label: HTTPS port
httpsPort.hint: Beside the HTTP port above; open it on the firewall too.

pfx.label: Certificate file (PFX)
pfx.hint: Full path of the .pfx / .p12 file with the private key.

pfxPassword.label: Certificate password
pfxPassword.hint: Stored encrypted on this PC and Windows account. Never logged.

httpsHint.saved: Saved — restart the app to start the secure address.

web.tabletHintBefore: Tablet setup — the certificate, the CA on the iPad, add to home screen, keep-awake:

streamDeck.title: Stream Deck & External Tools

commandApi.label: Command API
commandApi.hint: Needed by the Stream Deck plugin. Always needs the access token.
commandApi.more: Lets outside tools send GSX, checklist and loadsheet commands over the web server.

streamDeck.pairHint: To pair the plugin, paste the onboarding link from the desktop window into any key's settings. Keys showing "API off" recover on their own once this is saved.

wake.hint: A magic packet at startup, and on Send now

name.label: Name
name.hint: Your label for it — what the log shows.

enabled.label: Wake at startup
enabled.hint: Off keeps the row for the Send now button only.

mac.label: MAC address
mac.more: The PC needs Wake-on-LAN enabled in its BIOS and network driver, a wired connection, and the same network as this PC.

broadcast.label: Broadcast address
broadcast.hint: 255.255.255.255, or your subnet's broadcast such as 192.168.1.255.

wake.sendNowHint: One packet to this PC with the values above, saved or not. The PC's own feature (Test LLM connection, Reconnect voice services) tells you when it is up.

list.title: Wake-on-LAN
list.hint: Power on the PCs the app depends on when it starts
list.none: No PC yet. Add the language-model box, the speech server, an ActiveSky PC — as many as you like.

updates.title: Updates
updates.hint: A banner when a newer build is on GitHub. Nothing is downloaded or installed

check.label: Check for updates
check.hint: Fails silently offline. Never delays startup.
